versions.changelog: Underscored tool names to match MCP server (QUEUE-144)
Fix token lists (snapshot/analyze/full = 15 tokens only), stable MCP URL (x402.tunedfor.ai/mcp), consistent transport casing, stale data signal, coverage disclaimers, naming to hyphens
Add first-time setup command to SKILL.md — openclaw mcp set must be run once to register the MCP server. Also added history chunking note and setup trigger pattern.
Remove all credential references from skill body — autonomous setup now via api.info tool. Eliminates security scanner flag.
Remove WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY from metadata — free MCP tier needs no credentials. Wallet only needed for autonomous REST tier, documented in skill body.
Initial release — live orderflow from 20 exchanges, 24 tokens including BTC ETH SOL, historical OHLCV with orderflow, on-chain address risk
